description: United States National Transit Map Stops provides the National Transit Map Stops layer, derived from operators' GTFS schedules. The provider is US Bureau of Transportation Statistics. Geographical and temporal coverage: The nationwide United States layer was compiled on 9 March 2026 and locates transit boarding and alighting stops. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC0-1.0. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: This record covers the inspected stops layer, not every National Transit Map component. Participation and source feed completeness constrain coverage. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
